sources.title: Transparent Hugepage Support
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: cgroup v2：祖先限制與鄰居用量的容量帳本
related.titleEn: cgroup v2: ancestor limits and sibling memory accounting
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付位移清單、區塊分組、邊界測例與模型適用旗標；圖中區分有用資料與配置容量；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver offsets, region groups, boundary cases and an explicit applicability flag. In the visualization, distinguish useful data from allocated capacity and explain the observed-versus-assumed page-size boundary. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 建立父子樹與 usage、max、high 欄位；容量計算只用明示 max，high 另列為壓力控制而非硬容量替代。
related.differenceEn: Build the parent-child tree with usage, max and high fields. Use declared max values for this capacity calculation, while reporting high separately as a pressure-control setting rather than substituting it for a hard limit.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在強制成功配置 2 MiB 區塊的教學模型中，實體量為被觸碰的不同區塊數乘 2 MiB；頁面實際政策需另外觀察；每個基本頁 4 KiB，65 次各觸碰一頁；名義分散在 65 個 2 MiB 區塊，變更連續放進同一區塊；名義式 65*2 = 130 MiB；變更式 ceil(65*4/2048)*2 = 2 MiB。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

在不可回收且無其他支出的簡化前提下，子群可用預算為 min(子上限,父上限－兄弟用量)；這不是核心下一次配置結果的預測；父上限 12 GiB、子上限 10 GiB；兄弟用量由 5 增為 8 GiB，其他用量固定為零；名義式 min(10,12-5) = 7 GiB；變更式 min(10,12-8) = 4 GiB。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: In the deliberately idealized model where every touched region receives one 2 MiB allocation, footprint is distinct touched regions times 2 MiB. Real allocation policy, collapse and splitting require separate observations. Use sixty-five 4 KiB touches. Initially each lies in a different 2 MiB region; after relocation all sixty-five occupy consecutive pages in one region. Requested useful bytes remain 260 KiB. Nominal 65*2 = 130 MiB; changed ceil(65*4/2048)*2 = 2 MiB. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Assuming no reclaimable memory or other charges, available child budget is the smaller of its own limit and parent headroom after sibling usage. This does not predict a kernel allocation’s exact outcome. Parent capacity is 12 GiB and the child limit is 10 GiB. Sibling use changes from 5 to 8 GiB, with zero other charges and no reclaim in this synthetic snapshot. Nominal min(10,12-5) = 7 GiB; changed min(10,12-8) = 4 GiB. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: RoCE PFC：停止訊號往返中的緩衝餘裕
related.titleEn: RoCE PFC: buffer headroom during pause response
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付位移清單、區塊分組、邊界測例與模型適用旗標；圖中區分有用資料與配置容量；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver offsets, region groups, boundary cases and an explicit applicability flag. In the visualization, distinguish useful data from allocated capacity and explain the observed-versus-assumed page-size boundary. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 畫出暫停送出、來源停止、最後資料抵達三個事件；列出反應時間是否已包含往返與處理，避免重複加算。
related.differenceEn: Draw pause issuance, source stopping and last-data arrival events. Define whether the reaction interval already includes propagation and processing, so a round trip is neither omitted nor counted twice.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在強制成功配置 2 MiB 區塊的教學模型中，實體量為被觸碰的不同區塊數乘 2 MiB；頁面實際政策需另外觀察；每個基本頁 4 KiB，65 次各觸碰一頁；名義分散在 65 個 2 MiB 區塊，變更連續放進同一區塊；名義式 65*2 = 130 MiB；變更式 ceil(65*4/2048)*2 = 2 MiB。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

簡化餘裕為線速位元組率乘反應時間再加一個最大框；忽略晶片 cell 取整、額外 pipeline 與共享池競爭；教學資料率 25 GB/s，最大框 9000 B；反應時間由 3 微秒增加為 5 微秒；名義式 25e9*3e-6+9000 = 84000 B；變更式 25e9*5e-6+9000 = 134000 B。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: In the deliberately idealized model where every touched region receives one 2 MiB allocation, footprint is distinct touched regions times 2 MiB. Real allocation policy, collapse and splitting require separate observations. Use sixty-five 4 KiB touches. Initially each lies in a different 2 MiB region; after relocation all sixty-five occupy consecutive pages in one region. Requested useful bytes remain 260 KiB. Nominal 65*2 = 130 MiB; changed ceil(65*4/2048)*2 = 2 MiB. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Simplified headroom equals byte rate times reaction time plus one maximum frame. Hardware cell rounding, additional pipelines and competition for shared buffers are excluded and must be added before operational configuration. Use a synthetic 25 decimal GB/s arrival rate and a 9000-byte maximum frame. Reaction time increases from 3 to 5 microseconds, with no claim that either value is a switch’s configured default. Nominal 25e9*3e-6+9000 = 84000 B; changed 25e9*5e-6+9000 = 134000 B. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
